headline: Archipelago protects saves from other seeds; difficulty mod fixes Blarg Station spawns
summary: Archipelago now remembers which room belongs to each save slot and refuses saves from another seed, alongside logic and connection fixes. The difficulty mod reserves room for Blarg Station's own objects so extra enemies do not remove the ship and Clank on landing. Mod listing and publishing checks also became more reliable.
highlights: Archipelago fixes cover world packaging, logic, seed checks, reconnects and client messages (#24).
Save slots retain their Archipelago room using SDK 1.11 (#26).
At enemy count 2, Blarg Station now receives no enemy copies to preserve its object pool (#34).
Release jobs now trigger index rebuilding directly, and listing checks reject an unreadable newest release (#27, #32).
Listings gain a per-mod AI assistance field (#33).
